contributions.detail: Eleven of the thirteen Schedule A rows carry a figure and they sum EXACTLY to 4,017.45 (100+50+50+60+20+50+100+100+2337.45+150+1000), equal to the printed 'Subtotal for this page $4017.45', the printed 'Total Contributions Received $4017.45', Box B (This Period) AND Box C (Year-to-Date), which are equal - the two scopes coincide, so cumulative. The remaining TWO rows are in-kind donations the filer deliberately left unvalued (see the row notes and the page footnote); because the printed total closes exactly WITHOUT them, the side is COMPLETE and is NOT a floor.

expenditures.detail: Three Schedule B pages. p3 rows sum 3,203.23 = its printed page subtotal; p4 rows sum 2,493.33 = its printed page subtotal; p5 rows sum 1,171.59 = its printed page subtotal; the three page subtotals sum 6,868.15 = the printed 'Total Expenditures Made' on all three pages = Box D (This Period) = Box E (Year-to-Date). gates.page_subtotal: FOUR page gates, all exact. p2 contributions 4,017.45 = printed 4017.45. p3 expenditures 3,203.23 = printed 3203.23. p4 2,493.33 = printed 2493.33. p5 1,171.59 = printed 1171.59. Cross-page: 3203.23+2493.33+1171.59 = 6,868.15 = the printed report total. ARITHMETIC OVERRULED A GLYPH READ ON p3 ROW 7: at 200 dpi the amount read as '$826'; that made the page sum 4,020.97 against a printed 3,203.23 (delta 817.74). The value is '$8' with superscript cents '26' over the rule = 8.26, which makes the page close to the cent; a 450 dpi crop then confirmed the superscript independently. A Rhodes-pattern save: the page's own sum decided, not the resolution.
gates.row_count: Independent amount-column ink profile per page, scored against the printed rules (the filer writes ABOVE each rule, so row N is the band between rule N-1 and rule N). p2: rules detected at 15.48/20.05/24.61/29.16/33.75/38.30/42.84/47.39/51.95/56.43/61.00/65.57/70.11/74.66 pct - 13 inked bands, 13 rows emitted (2 of them carrying in-kind text instead of a figure). p3: 15 value bands, 15 rows. p4: 15 value bands, 15 rows. p5: 5 value bands, 5 rows. rowbands.py was not run; the per-column ink profile is the sharper independent count on this underline (non-boxed) form and every page also closes on its printed subtotal.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: crop of the FIRST row's amount box pct:81.00,16.45,15.00,3.40 at 600 dpi renders '100' (row 1's own value; the clerk's received stamp bleeds into the top-left corner of the box); crop of the LAST row's box pct:81.00,71.06,15.00,3.40 renders '$1000'; the control box one row-pitch (4.55%) past the last row renders EMPTY. Proof passes on the page with the most rows and the worst skew.
gates.balance_chain: CLOSES EXACTLY, twice. Box A 3,000.00 + Box B 4,017.45 = 7,017.45 = Box F; Box F 7,017.45 - Box D 6,868.15 = 149.30 = Balance at Close. Worth a human eye, though not an error on its face: Box C (contributions year-to-date) equals Box B, so the $3,000 opening balance is not counted as year-to-date contributions - consistent with it being carried in from before the reporting year, but it means Box C alone understates the money that passed through the account. No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so the cross-filing cumulative chain was not run here.

escalation_note: 450 dpi amount-column strip crops over every row of p2, p3, p4 and p5 (re-read identically; verified=1 on every row) and, on p3, the decisive re-read of '$8' + superscript '26'; 600 dpi single-cell crops of the p2 first row, last row and control for the geometry proof; a widened 600 dpi re-crop of the p2 first row after the initial box clipped the leading digit.
notes: THE DOCUMENT CONTRADICTS THE CHUNK FILE ON OFFICE: the chunk says 'Clerk/Auditor'; the cover's Office line is handwritten 'Cache County Clerk'. Transcribed from the form. Amendment: NEITHER 'No' NOR 'Yes' is marked - the filer left the amendment question blank. Report type marked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'. Date of Report handwritten '28 OCT 2024' on the cover and all five page footers; the chunk file's 2024-11-01 appears nowhere on the form. Pages 2-5 are the schedules (ONE Schedule A page, THREE Schedule B pages) and page 6 is the Summary Page; the footers number them 2..6, so the report is complete. TWO UNVALUED IN-KIND CONTRIBUTIONS (Schedule A lines 6 and 7): the amount cells carry the words 'In kind donation of use of reception hall Old Rock Church' and 'In kind donation Fundraiser Dinner for 50' instead of a figure, and a footnote at the foot of the page, signed DRG, reads 'No attempt has been made to assign a cost to the two considerable In Kind donations.' Those two rows are emitted with a BLANK amount and needs_review:1 - the blank is the filer's deliberate omission, NOT illegibility, and because the printed schedule total closes exactly without them the side is complete rather than a floor. in_kind is set true on those two rows on the strength of the 'In kind donation' label plus the * / ** legend; this form has no in-kind column and no in-kind flag is inferred anywhere else. THE CACHE CFD FORM HAS NO SEPARATE '$50.00 or less' AGGREGATE LINE, so the sub-$50 trap does not arise: Schedule A is the whole contribution record, and the filer itemised sub-$50 gifts too (line 5 is $20). PRIVACY: contributor street addresses, a PO box and, in Kent Hatch's cell, a telephone number are printed in the clear on these pages and were discarded at read time - only city/state are emitted. On Schedule B the filer wrote each vendor's street address ABOVE the vendor name inside the same cell; only the vendor name is carried into vendor_raw. A clerk received-stamp artifact runs vertically down the right margin of p2 near the Amount header - a stamp, not a field. CALIBRATION-SPECIMEN CANDIDATE: p3 row 7 ('$8' + superscript '26' misreading as '$826' at 200 dpi, caught and reversed by the page subtotal) is a clean, self-proving specimen of the arithmetic-outranks-glyph rule on a superscript-cents form.
